share.title: 📡 SHARED STATS (anonymous, opt-in)
share.status_no_pseudo: No pseudo set (you'll appear on the leaderboard with your anon_id only)
share.usage: Subcommands: enable --confirm | name <pseudo> | disable | submit | forget | status
share.name_usage: To set: /pokemon stats-share name <pseudo>     To clear: /pokemon stats-share name clear
share.name_invalid: Invalid pseudo. Must match [a-zA-Z0-9_-] and be 2-24 chars (no spaces, no accents).
share.name_set_hint: Publicly visible on the leaderboard after your next submit. Run /pokemon stats-share submit to push it now.
share.name_cleared: ✓ Pseudo cleared. Next submit will revert to anon_id only on leaderboard.
share.privacy_notice:
What gets sent (only): anon_id (locally generated, not tied to identity), display_name (only if you set one via `name <pseudo>`, otherwise empty), lifetime_stats (tokens, evolutions, shinies, max_level, lineages_completed, games_won/played), active.lineage + level, badges, pokedex_seen_count.
  What is NOT sent: IP (server-side stripped), conversations, file paths, team, detailed pokédex, items, friendship, precise total_xp.
  Your pseudo (if set) is PUBLIC on the leaderboard. Pick one you're OK displaying.
  Max 1 submit per 24h. Right-to-delete via /pokemon stats-share forget (GDPR).
share.enabled: ✓ Shared stats enabled. anon_id: %s. Run /pokemon stats-share submit to push your first stats.
share.disabled: ✓ Disabled. No more data will be sent.
share.disable_hint: Note: data already on the server stays. Use `forget` to delete it (GDPR).
share.no_id: No local anon_id — you've never submitted stats.
share.forget_failed: Delete failed — check connection or retry.
share.not_enabled: Shared stats not enabled. Run /pokemon stats-share enable --confirm first.
share.submit_failed: Submit failed (HTTP %s). Check connection or retry later.

arena.title: ⚔️  ARENA — async PvP
arena.status_disabled: Disabled. Run /pokemon arena enable --confirm to opt in.
arena.usage: Subcommands: enable --confirm | disable | regenerate | opponents [N] | challenge <anon_id> | battle [<id>] | status
arena.no_anon_id: No anon_id yet. Enable shared stats first: /pokemon stats-share enable --confirm
arena.no_active: No active companion. Run /pokemon hatch first.
arena.no_secret: Arena secret missing locally. Run /pokemon arena disable then /pokemon arena enable --confirm to re-pair.
arena.privacy_notice:
What gets sent (only): anon_id, display_name (if set), lineage, level, is_shiny.
  What is NOT sent: total_xp, conversations, files, items, friendship, pokédex.
  Opponents will see your snapshot (anon_id + lineage + level + shiny) on the public list.
  An arena_secret will be generated server-side and stored locally (chmod 600). It is required to challenge other trainers.
  You can opt out at any time with /pokemon arena disable.
arena.enabled: ✓ Arena enabled. anon_id: %s. Run /pokemon arena opponents to find rivals.
arena.already_enabled: Already enabled. Use /pokemon arena regenerate to rotate the secret.
arena.disabled: ✓ Disabled. Local secret cleared, removed from arena pool.
arena.not_enabled: Arena not enabled. Run /pokemon arena enable --confirm first.
arena.regen_ok: ✓ Secret rotated. Old secret invalidated, new one stored locally.
arena.opponents_hint: Pick an anon_id then: /pokemon arena challenge <anon_id>
arena.battle_usage: Usage: /pokemon arena battle <battle_id>     (or /pokemon arena battle for your last one)
